en.topic_title: Court rejects ex-press union head Ronson Chan’s bid to take police obstruction appeal to top court
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong court has rejected a former press union head’s bid to lodge a final appeal against his conviction for obstructing police, for which he was jailed for five days.



Hong Kong Journalists Association chairperson Ronson Chan outside the High Court on Sept. 6, 2023. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Deputy High Court Judge Lily Wong on Friday refused to grant Ronson Chan, a former chair of the Hong Kong Journalists Association (HKJA), a certificate to take his challenge to the Court of Final
